content.text: No non-compete or field-of-use covenant exists anywhere in the agreement, and the survival clause has no such restriction to carry forward.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use covenant binding the Customer, so the preferred position is met. Searches for "compet*", "exclusiv*", "restrict", "solicit", "similar/field of use/territory" and negative-covenant phrasings ("Customer will/shall not", "agrees not to") returned no restrictive covenant on our business. To the contrary, p0001 affirmatively disclaims any exclusive arrangement and expressly preserves AP's right to offer or sell Inventory through other agents or to third parties — language that benefits us and should be retained. The only "Customer will not" language, in p0025 (Use of Service), is ordinary license-scope and IP protection (no transfer or third-party access, no derivative works, no reverse engineering, no resale or service-bureau use of Kubient's Service). Those limits govern how we may use Kubient's own technology; they do not restrict the businesses AP may operate or the products AP may buy, build or license from others, so they are not a field-of-use restriction under this rule. The general survival provision in p0070 carries forward no such covenant because none exists. No redline is required.
